about_the_game:
A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times.”

That's what she called herself.

The “monster shop” that controls the followers of the monsters.

The maid who is not a monster, but a follower of the monster shop.

And then there is the person who claims to be a “dragon survivor,” whom the protagonist meets.

The story unfolds in a retro-futuristic world.

A mysterious and bizarre tale.

A text-based novel game with point-and-click exploration.

The game is deeply influenced by both novels and movies, and contains many cinematic effects.

The difficulty level is fairly low, and the game is almost a one-step novel.

The demo version is the first 5 minutes of the game.
